terms.definition: The length-1 Arrow Array carrying one OPC UA value.
An Arrow RecordBatch column whose `DataType` is the Part 6 mapping for the DataSet field DataType.
An Arrow validity-bitmap null. Null slots are the canonical null mechanism.
An OPC UA multi-dimensional array represented as dimensions plus row-major values.
The DataTypeEncoding Object for the Arrow encoding of an OPC UA DataType; the analogue of Default Binary, Default XML and Default JSON.

The first 8 bytes of the SHA-256 fingerprint of the serialized Arrow `Schema` IPC message bytes; it identifies the exact Arrow schema needed to decode a payload and is independent of PubSub ConfigurationVersion.
The `batch` `ArrowIpcFormat`: a single Arrow RecordBatch message with no preceding IPC Schema message, whose schema is resolved out of band by SchemaId.
Arrow Database Connectivity — a client API surface (`Connection → Statement → ExecuteQuery → ArrowArrayStream`).

table.description: Namespace for *NodeIds* and *BrowseNames* defined in the OPC UA specification. This namespace shall have namespace index 0.
